correctness.rationale: The recursive-tree increasing-tree decomposition gives dF/dx=u exp(z[(1-p)B+pG]), with exp(-pG)=1-u+u(1-x)^p. The exact conditional increments EA=1/n, ED=pR/n and EAD=p/n yield a telescoping covariance recurrence and positive sign for n>=3. The normalized root-cluster martingale has bounded L2 moments by its explicit second-moment recursion. Splitting original root attachments at m_n=floor(exp(sqrt(log n))) gives a Gaussian late sum independent of the early martingale limit, which proves the independent joint limit. Exact rational enumerations independently verify 345 assertions at finite sizes. Restrictions p in (0,1), n>=3 for strictness and the role of marginals are explicit. L2 convergence and asymptotic scales are separately justified.

value.rationale: Root offspring is a natural local growth statistic while its percolated retained component is a macroscopic random cluster; their finite covariance and asymptotic decoupling answer a structurally motivated dependence question that marginal cluster or degree formulas cannot answer. The marked generating function also provides every finite mixed moment and makes the origin of positive dependence transparent, rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
